history.content: ok so this is gonna sound dumb but i found a box of old photos cleaning out the closet and i feel... nothing? like genuinely nothing lol. shouldnt that do something
A box of old photos and then just... nothing, that stands out. Not dumb at all, and I’m here with the blank part if you want to stay with it.

the blank part yeah. i mean theres pics of me and my dad in there from when i was like 8, fishing trips, the whole bit. people would cry at this stuff right? i just sorted them into a pile like it was junk mail
The “sorted them into a pile like it was junk mail” part feels very blank, maybe even shut down. Does it feel more like nothing is getting through, or like something is there but far away?

honestly? probably the far away one. like i KNOW i should feel sad, my dad and i havent really talked in like 6 years, but instead its just this flat hum. and the dumb part is theres also this little bit of me thats kinda relieved i dont feel anything, which is a great look im sure
That flat hum, with a little relief sitting alongside it, feels like a lot of distance in one small moment. We can stay with just that, if you want.

relief is a strong word for it lol. more like... if i dont feel anything then i dont have to decide whether to call him or whatever. the numbness is kind of doing me a favor you know? saves me a phone call
The numbness doing you a favor, by sparing you a phone call, feels very practical. I’m hearing that this isn’t just blank, it’s doing work for you.
huh. yeah maybe. its easier to file it under junk mail than to actually sit with the fact that i miss him and i'm still mad at him at the same time. anyway. that got heavier than i meant it to lol

yeah lets leave it there i think. but thats... actually kind of it isnt it. missing him and mad at him and the numbness just my brain not wanting to pick. thanks for not making it weird. gonna go put the box away
That feels settled enough for now, and I’m glad it could stay plain. Take care of the box.
